avis.titre: Like the texture, not sure if effective
avis.texte: I have dry, non-sensitive skin and I love the feel of this! It's slippery and feels moisturizing to me. I've used it with a few different serums and moisturizers and never had it pill. That being said, there's not a ton of science behind the effectiveness of azaleic acid derivatives, and there arent many other brightening ingredients in here. It has a slight raspberry scent (likely from raspberry ketone, which was also in their brightening spf)

I am always happy with the Naturium products that I've tried, and the milky toner is no exception. It has no scent, a milky texture that feels cool on my skin, and leaves it with a subtle glow and feeling very moisturized. I wish there were more product for the price, but it is still a great product overall.

I've struggled with stubborn breakouts and redness and this has been the only product to gently address both issues and smooth the overall texture of my skin! I love using this in the morning or at night.
Theres nothing milky about this other than the color. It killed my skin and made me look like I had a terrible sunburn and also FELT like I did. Never again.

My rosacea hates to see this product coming. Ironically, I chose this as my first milky toner to try ever because of the azelaic acid derivative and it being potentially beneficial for my rosacea. This product irritated my skin barrier, it always made me turn bright red after application. It also made me break out which never happens to me. It caused my skin to itch throughout the day and when I would scratch the product would peel. It also made makeup that is applied in top look dry and it also made the makeup peel. A disaster of a product for me.

I thought because of the vehicle (milky hydrating toner) this wouldnt irritate my skin but unfortunately it did. Feels nice, but doesnt work for my sensitive skin. It didnt burn or sting, but my face was soooo red and splotchy all over right after using. Bummed!

I use this toner every morning with a hydrating serum and then my sunscreen and its perfect. Its important to note that this is NOT meant to be a "hydrating" toner, this is meant to brighten and improve the texture of your skin, and you may need to add extra moisture elsewhere. That being said, for what it is, its one of my favorite toners I have ever tried. There is a noticeable difference in the brightness and texture of my skin after several weeks of using. I love it! Will definitely be repurchasing.

As a regular user of retinol, retinal, and exfoliating acids (in moderation), I wanted a product with Azelaic Acid to add to my routine, and I'm thrilled with the results after a week. **Skin Type:** Combo and Acne Prone (whiteheads and dark spots) **Reasons for Purchase:** 1. Azelaic Acid complements retinol without increasing redness or sensitivity, though sun sensitivity still requires SPF. 2. It helps reduce redness, providing a calming effect without adding extra steps to my routine. 3. I wanted a "milky" toner since the Laneige cream skin refiner didn't offer the hydration I needed at a price I liked.

I broke out from the 2nd use. The 2nd ingredient is pore clogging along w other ingredients that are not sensitive skin friendly. Naturium has gone down hill for sure. The ONLY good thing is body butter …for now.

I love many Naturium products (all the glycolic and retinol stuff, body lotions, Barrier bounce, lip balms) but this and the serum they pair this with in an orange bottle too was not for me. In their defense though I usually hate toners, I've never gotten one that didn't cause problems!
